mapper.select: SELECT /* com.seinfo.protoA.component.file.mapper.selectMfileGroup */ mfile_group_id, reg_dt, reg_user_id, mfile_info_id FROM seinfo_mfile_group WHERE mfile_group_id = #{mfileGrpId}
SELECT /* com.seinfo.protoA.util.token.TokenMapper.selectMfileGroupCnt */ count(*) FROM seinfo_mfile_group where mfile_group_id = #{mfileGrpId}

SELECT /* com.seinfo.protoA.component.file.mapper.selectMfileInfoByFileGroupId */ b.mfile_info_id ,b.mfile_info_title ,b.mfile_info_method ,b.mfile_info_desc ,b.mfile_max_cnt ,b.mfile_max_size ,b.mfile_max_size AS file_max_size ,b.mfile_ext FROM seinfo_mfile_group a, seinfo_mfile_info b WHERE a.mfile_info_id = b.mfile_info_id AND a.mfile_group_id = #{mfileGrpId}

SELECT /* com.seinfo.protoA.component.file.mapper.selectMfileInfo */ mfile_info_id , mfile_info_title , mfile_info_method , mfile_info_desc , mfile_max_cnt , mfile_max_size , mfile_ext FROM seinfo_mfile_info WHERE mfile_info_id = #{mfileInfoId}
SELECT /* com.seinfo.protoA.component.file.mapper.selectMfileListCnt */ count(*) FROM seinfo_mfile_list WHERE mfile_group_id = #{mfileGrpId}

SELECT /* com.seinfo.protoA.component.file.mapper.selectMfileListClient */ mfile_id as file_id ,mfile_nm as file_nm ,mfile_size as file_size ,mfile_path as mfile_path FROM seinfo_mfile_list WHERE mfile_group_id = #{mfileGrpId}
mapper.update: UPDATE /* com.seinfo.protoA.util.token.TokenMapper.updateMfileDown */ seinfo_mfile_down SET mfile_down_yn = 'Y' ,mfile_down_dt = now() WHERE mfile_down_id = #{mfileDownId} AND reg_user_id = #{regUserId} AND mfile_down_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT /* com.seinfo.protoA.component.file.mapper.selectMfileDown */ mfile_down_id , mfile_down_yn , mfile_down_dt , mfile_down_type , mfile_down_path , mfile_nm , reg_user_id , mfile_id , mfile_group_id FROM seinfo_mfile_down WHERE mfile_down_id = #{mfileDownId} AND reg_user_id = #{regUserId} AND mfile_down_yn = 'N'

SELECT /* com.seinfo.protoA.component.file.mapper.selectMfileListPath */ mfile_path , mfile_nm FROM seinfo_mfile_list WHERE mfile_group_id = ( SELECT mfile_group_id FROM seinfo_mfile_down WHERE mfile_down_id = #{mfileDownId} )
